title: Localization and total-limit assembly from representative map equalities
statement: In the setting of [stage3-pur-scalar-tensor-limit-good-representatives], the explicit equality of the realized maps on every good localization representative implies the completed scalar/tensor limit square. This is the localization, completion, and total-limit transport stage.

proof.text: Use localization by K-flat good representatives, naturality of the scalar and tensor realization models, and functoriality of the coefficient total limit to transport the representative map equality to arbitrary constructible inputs.
